reference: frozen Stage15 epoch-16 HAM validation only; identical split and class order
checkpoint_selection: minimum common unweighted validation focal loss among eligible epochs; earlier epoch breaks exact ties
candidate_interpretation: one-factor exploratory validation-only candidate, not causal proof or external confirmation

decision_logic.CLEAR_VALIDATION_IMPROVEMENT: The eligible Stage23 candidate is no worse than Stage15 on every registered aggregate and classwise validation metric (higher-is-better metrics) and has strictly lower validation focal loss or at least one strict metric improvement, with no metric regression.
decision_logic.MIXED_VALIDATION_RESULT: The eligible Stage23 candidate strictly improves at least one of accuracy, macro F1, MEL recall, or MEL F1, but also regresses on another registered comparison metric or fails full non-regression.
decision_logic.NO_MEANINGFUL_IMPROVEMENT: The eligible Stage23 candidate does not strictly improve any of accuracy, macro F1, MEL recall, or MEL F1 over Stage15 validation and does not satisfy the clear-improvement rule.
decision_logic.NO_CANDIDATE_SELECTED: No Stage23 epoch satisfies every unchanged Stage15 eligibility gate.
decision_logic.EXPERIMENT_INVALID: Any frozen protocol, provenance, data-boundary, numerical, or artifact-integrity check fails.
